messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — PR #12188 (chat-scaling): locally green but CI is flaky on integration-tests. Deploy freeze hits in ~6h. Thinking we either wait for the morning rebase window or try to get a rapid rerun and approvals. any opinions?
phil: which job is flaking? can we rerun now? :eyes:
ci-bot: CI status: integration-tests failed on node-3 — timeout waiting for websocket connection. Logs: https://ci.example/12188/logs/98765
tara: if the failure is the websocket test it's related to the env, not the code path we changed, but we should be cautious. Is this blocking the canary?
morgan: it affects the chat-scaling e2e that runs in canary. If we land and the test is flaky in prod, we could push a false-positive rollback. I'd prefer to either get a clean rerun + @natalie approval or wait for the rebase window tomorrow morning (10:00 UTC).
phil: i'll kick a rerun now and peek at the test. ping me if you want me to bisect.
phil: rerun started... :gear:
ci-bot: CI status: rerun triggered by phil — build 12188.2
release-manager: quick reminder: deploy freeze starts 22:00 UTC and ends 04:00 UTC. Any merges that touch runtime should avoid the 22:00–04:00 window unless there's an emergency.
morgan: noted, thanks. If rerun passes, we still need final API approval from @natalie (there's a minor schema bump).
natalie: I can review in ~30m. If the rerun passes and there are no schema surprises, I can approve. If it's still flaky, we should schedule for the morning rebase window.
tara: could we split the change (move the schema bump into a follow-up) to land the perf bits earlier?
morgan: technically possible but risky — perf bits depend on the schema change for the new header. Splitting would add complexity and a quick PR anyway.
phil: rerun completed — integration-tests still failed on the same websocket timeout. digging into the container logs now.
phil: looks like the test harness is timing out at 45s consistently on node-3 only. Not seeing relevant code regressions in this PR. Could be infra noise.
morgan: thanks. Given that, i'm leaning to hold until infra is stable or we get a green on a rerun. We don't want to burn a freeze slot.
ci-bot: CI status: scheduled rerun in 10 minutes (auto-retry policy).
natalie: i reviewed the API changes in the PR diff — looks fine to me, no breaking changes. happy to approve once CI is green.
phil: meanwhile i'll open a ticket for infra to check node-3 intermittent networking: INFRA-2845, assigning to eng-infra.
phil: INFRA-2845: node-3 websocket timeouts — logs attached. pinging @eng-infra.
release-manager: thanks — if infra confirms environment flakiness, we can back off and land after they remediate. Otherwise, we can book the rebase slot at 10:00 UTC tomorrow.
morgan: sounds good. i'll hold the PR and set it to 'needs-approval' so it doesn't get auto-merged. Please @mention me when CI is green or infra confirms fix.
phil: noted. if anyone needs to run this locally quickly, the failing test is chat_e2e/websocket_connect_spec.rb — run with: 
```
RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rspec spec/integration/chat_e2e/websocket_connect_spec.rb --tag node3
```
morgan: thanks — i'll follow the infra ticket.
ci-bot: CI status: auto-rerun completed — integration-tests passed on node-3 this time. build 12188.3 
phil: sweet. re-checking flaky logs, looks transient.
morgan: great — @natalie can you give final thumbs? :pray:
natalie: approved. :white_check_mark: feel free to merge in the next non-freeze window; if you want it in the immediate window, ping me and i can approve out-of-band (but prefer to avoid freeze).
morgan: merging in the morning 10:00 UTC rebase slot. Thanks all for quick help. :tada:
